claim: One act of sight carries through the live substrate intact: what was seen is held at the standing its evidence warrants, judged by the same band that judges a recognition and a finished task, recorded so the memory of it resolves to the bytes, read through the law that governs the substrate — and changes nothing about what it may do.
hypothesis: Each stage of this path passes its own test. The defects found today all lived in the SEAMS — a value computed by one stage and dropped before the next could read it — and no single-stage test can see one. This exercises the whole chain in one run.

checks.label: the substrate is the live one, with its faculties up
sight returned a percept through the one entry point
the percept has a durable identity: the memory of the seeing
what was seen is held as beliefs
an INFERRED claim is held at its own measured support
while a MEASURED claim is not — they entered by different evidence
a recognition below the floor is not held at all
checks.detail: quality 0.02 < floor 0.5; 0 belief(s) — absence, not a weak posterior (memory mem_575f03741481470284dcbacf5d925675 supplied, so the floor is the only thing refusing it)

checks.label: the sensing produced a judgement, not only beliefs
every claim it made was judged, none skipped
each claim carries its own verdict and the posterior behind it
the percept's own verdict is the WEAKEST of its claims
it fans out on the SAME event a recognition does
and names which path produced it, so the two stay distinguishable
the memory records WHICH percept it is of
which resolves to the memory of the seeing, digest and all
every blob it saw is read through the law, none skipped
a refusal is still a refusal after a whole act of sight
and affect still reaches no law
checks.detail: stakes is an appraisal dimension, and no law reads appraisal (asserted against the law bodies in BEARING-01)

checks.label: an inferred claim it is unsure of is flagged, not acted on
while the claims it measured are still acted on
so the percept's own verdict is VERIFY — the weakest claim decides
and the reaction can name what to re-observe from the payload alone
the reaction carries the VERIFY verdict out without raising

notes: Before this the whole percept shared one envelope quality, so a shape inferred from a lossy polygon approximation and a width read off the file were equally well founded in the record. The support existed at every point and was dropped at the seam: `concept_ingestion` truncated every edge to three elements at extraction, before the reader of the fourth ever ran.

`perceive` asked of every recognition whether its confidence cleared a defensible bar; `sense` ran to the belief store and stopped. The substrate held an acceptance standard for what it RECOGNISED and none for what it SAW — on the path that runs constantly and that an attacker reaches first.

A shape and a colour bear on no interest the law protects, and the reading says so as NONE or VACANT rather than as an absence of reading. That is the honest result for a test card: the faculty fires, and finds nothing at stake.

The test card is clean, so every claim it yields is high-support and the loop only ever exercised ACT. The branch that matters is the other one: what the substrate does when it is NOT sure. It was broken here and no single-stage test could see it, because both stages were individually correct and disagreed about the payload.
